boss_intro: Ah. The famous Max. I've read your file. Spelling: atrocious. Spirit: concerning.
Welcome to my gearworks. Please observe the machinery. It will be observing you.
A duel, then. I do hope you brought a method. I brought forty-seven.
taunt: Sloppy footwork. See me after class.
My turrets have better aim than your enthusiasm.
Every move you make, I file under 'predictable'.
I calculated this fight last Tuesday. You lose in the third act.
hit_react: A palpable hit. Noted. Filed. Frowned at.
You scratched the paintwork. The PAINTWORK.
low_hp: My schematics say this isn't happening. My schematics are… revising.
You are ahead of the syllabus, dinosaur.
defeat_freed: The Cog — detached. Oh. OH. My mind is my OWN again. …It's rather nice in here.
Beaten by a student who shows their working. Acceptable. Commendable, even.
I concede. Gracefully. Elegantly. With only minimal sulking.
That gear puzzle — you solved it under fire. Front of the class. Café later; bring questions.
shield: My shield generator laughs at your efforts. Solve the gears or bounce off forever, dear.
Still shielded! The gear puzzle is at the arena's edge — do try to keep up.
No puzzle, no progress. THAT is engineering.
